about.text:
You need to build an application using Vue.js, Vuex, Vue Router, and Vuetify. The application header should contain a menu with two items: “About” and “Map”. The main section of the application should display the content of these sections.

“About” Section

This section should contain the text of this assignment, styled in a similar way.

“Map” Section

This section should display a map and a list (see example):

  1. 1. When clicking the “Add” button, the map should switch to marker-adding mode: clicking on the map should place a marker at that location, and a corresponding entry with the address should appear in the list.
    1. a. To find the address, you may use any free geocoding API, for example: https://geocode.maps.co/.
    2. b. If the address cannot be found, an error should be displayed and the marker should not be added to the list.
  2. 2. When clicking a marker on the map, the corresponding entry in the list should be highlighted.
  3. 3. When clicking an entry in the list, the map should center on the corresponding marker.
  4. 4. Markers should be stored locally and must persist after the page is reloaded.
  5. 5. The browser’s address bar should display the ID of the selected marker. Local data storage should be implemented via a service that emulates a backend. (You need a Backend class that pseudo-asynchronously saves data in localStorage.)

Additionally:

  1. 1. Consider the display on mobile devices.
  2. 2. Provide localization support.
  3. 3. Write one unit test for any component using Jest.

Reminder:

This test assignment is intended to demonstrate your ability to write well-structured modular code and effectively use the listed technologies (and more). You should be proud of this code.
